openQuestions.q: The execution plan (Phase 3) requires stale project-local .claude/agents to be *mechanically detected* by doctor/verify before any migration. The description says init itself does the migration (CHK-004). Do these two requirements conflict, or is init allowed to detect-and-migrate without a separate doctor phase?
openQuestions.evidence: Execution plan Phase 3: "If .claude/agents/*.md exists and the project is not explicitly in full-asset/debug mode, warn or fail with a clear migration path." Phase 4: "Migration must be explicit. Do not auto-delete project files during normal commands." Description: "init writes 0 agent files into the project, and pre-existing project-local .claude/agents is migrated/cleaned" (CHK-004 title: migrated already-initialized projects).
openQuestions.resolution: 以执行计划 Phase 4 迁移必须显式、普通命令不得自动删除项目文件为准。重构 CHK-004:普通 lattice init 永不静默删除 project-local agent 文件——fresh 项目 init 只同步全局 + 项目零 agent 文件(无删除);检测到已有 project-local 管理文件时 init 仅 WARN + 提示运行 lattice init --upgrade。真正的删除/迁移只在显式 --upgrade 下执行,只按 16 个精确管理 basename 删除、逐条 log、用户自建文件保留。既满足用户 init 不再生成那么多 .md(fresh 路径零文件),又满足 Phase 4 显式迁移约束。
